metadata.title: GeoSPARQL Ontology
metadata.description: An RDF/OWL vocabulary for representing spatial information

classes.label: Feature
classes.definition: A discrete spatial phenomenon in a universe of discourse.
classes.comment: A Feature represents a uniquely identifiable phenomenon, for example a river or an apple. While such phenomena (and therefore the Features used to represent them) are bounded, their boundaries may be crisp (e.g., the declared boundaries of a state), vague (e.g., the delineation of a valley versus its neighboring mountains), and change with time (e.g., a storm front). While discrete in nature, Features may be created from continuous observations, such as an isochrone that determines the region that can be reached by ambulance within 5 minutes.

classes.label: Geometry
classes.definition: A coherent set of direct positions in space. The positions are held within a Spatial Reference System (SRS).
classes.comment: Geometry can be used as a representation of the shape, extent or location of a Feature and may exist as a self-contained entity.

classes.label: Spatial Object
classes.definition: Anything spatial (being or having a shape, position or an extent).
classes.comment: Subclasses of this class are expected to be used for instance data.

classes.label: Spatial Object Collection
classes.definition: A collection of individual Spatial Objects.
classes.comment: This is the superclass of Feature Collection and Geometry Collection.

objectProperties.label: default geometry
objectProperties.definition: The default Geometry to be used in spatial calculations. It is usually the most detailed Geometry.

objectProperties.label: contains
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject spatially contains the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: T*TFF*FF*

objectProperties.label: covered by
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject is spatially covered by the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: TFF*TFT**

objectProperties.label: covers
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject spatially covers the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: T*TFT*FF*

objectProperties.label: disjoint
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject is spatially disjoint from the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: FF*FF****

objectProperties.label: equals
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject spatially equals the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: TFFFTFFFT

objectProperties.label: inside
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject is spatially inside the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: TFF*FFT**

objectProperties.label: meet
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject spatially meets the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: FT******* ^ F**T***** ^ F***T****

objectProperties.label: overlap
objectProperties.definition: States that the subject SpatialObject spatially overlaps the object SpatialObject. DE-9IM: T*T***T**

objectProperties.label: has area
objectProperties.definition: The area of a Spatial Object.

objectProperties.label: has bounding box
objectProperties.definition: The minimum or smallest bounding or enclosing box of a given Feature.

objectProperties.label: has centroid
objectProperties.definition: The arithmetic mean position of all the Geometry points of a given Feature.

objectProperties.label: has default geometry
objectProperties.definition: The default Geometry to be used in spatial calculations. It is usually the most detailed Geometry.

objectProperties.label: has geometry
objectProperties.definition: A spatial representation for a given Feature.

objectProperties.label: has length
objectProperties.definition: The length of a Spatial Object.

objectProperties.label: has perimeter length
objectProperties.definition: The length of the perimeter of a Spatial Object.

objectProperties.label: has size
objectProperties.definition: Subproperties of this property are used to indicate the size of a Spatial Object as a measurement or estimate of one or more dimensions of the Spatial Object's spatial presence.

objectProperties.label: has spatial accuracy
objectProperties.definition: The positional accuracy of the coordinates of a Geometry.

objectProperties.label: has spatial resolution
objectProperties.definition: The spatial resolution of a Geometry.

objectProperties.label: has volume
objectProperties.definition: The volume of a three-dimensional Spatial Object.

dataProperties.label: coordinate dimension
dataProperties.definition: The number of measurements or axes needed to describe the position of this Geometry in a coordinate system.

dataProperties.label: dimension
dataProperties.definition: The topological dimension of this geometric object, which must be less than or equal to the coordinate dimension. In non-homogeneous collections, this will return the largest topological dimension of the contained objects.

dataProperties.label: has area in square meters
dataProperties.definition: The area of a Spatial Object in square meters.

dataProperties.label: has length in meters
dataProperties.definition: The length of a Spatial Object in meters.

dataProperties.label: has perimeter length in meters
dataProperties.definition: The length of the perimeter of a Spatial Object in meters.

dataProperties.label: has metric size
dataProperties.definition: Subproperties of this property are used to indicate the size of a Spatial Object, as a measurement or estimate of one or more dimensions of the Spatial Object's spatial presence. Units are always metric (meter, square meter or cubic meter).

dataProperties.label: has spatial accuracy in meters
dataProperties.definition: The positional accuracy of the coordinates of a Geometry in meters.

dataProperties.label: has spatial resolution in meters
dataProperties.definition: The spatial resolution of a Geometry in meters.

dataProperties.label: has volume in cubic meters
dataProperties.definition: The volume of a Spatial Object in cubic meters.

dataProperties.label: has serialization
dataProperties.definition: Connects a Geometry object with its text-based serialization.

dataProperties.label: is empty
dataProperties.definition: (true) if this geometric object is the empty Geometry. If true, then this geometric object represents the empty point set for the coordinate space.

dataProperties.label: is simple
dataProperties.definition: (true) if this geometric object has no anomalous geometric points, such as self intersection or self tangency.

dataProperties.label: spatial dimension
dataProperties.definition: The number of measurements or axes needed to describe the spatial position of this Geometry in a coordinate system.
